description: Read campaigns, fundraising activity, supporters and transactions from GoFundMe Pro.

gofundme_pro_new_donation_trigger.description: Runs for each successful donation to your GoFundMe Pro organization, or to one campaign, with the donor's name and email, the amount and whether it repeats. Failed and test payments don't start it, nor do donations already there when the workflow is turned on. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.billing_first_name: The first name on the payment.
output.billing_last_name: The last name on the payment.
output.campaign_id: The campaign it was given to.
output.comment: The donor's comment, if they left one.
output.company_name: The company the donor gave for, if any.
output.donation_amount: The donation, a plain number such as 25.00.
output.frequency: one-time, or how often it repeats, such as monthly.
output.fundraising_page_id: The fundraising page it came through, if any.
output.in_honor_of: Who the donation honors, if anyone.
output.is_anonymous: Whether the donor asked to stay anonymous.
output.supporter_id: The donor's supporter ID, for Get a supporter.
output.total_amount: Everything paid in the transaction, a plain number.
output.transaction_id: The transaction's ID, for Get a transaction.

parameters.description: The GoFundMe Pro organization to watch.
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.description: Optional. Only donations to this campaign, by its ID from List campaigns. Leave blank for every campaign.
parameters.name: campaign_id

gofundme_pro_new_supporter_trigger.description: Runs for each new supporter in your GoFundMe Pro organization, whether they gave, registered or were added by hand, with their name, email and address. Supporters already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.address1: The first line of their address.
output.origin: How they came to be a supporter, as GoFundMe Pro records it.
output.source_campaign_id: The campaign they first came through, if any.
output.supporter_id: The supporter's ID, for Get a supporter.

parameters.description: The GoFundMe Pro organization to watch.
parameters.name: organization_id
